name: airbnb-search
description: Search Airbnb listings with advanced filtering and get detailed property information
long_description: A comprehensive MCP Bundle for searching Airbnb listings with various filters including location, dates, guest count, price range, and more. Get detailed information about specific properties including amenities, policies, location details, and highlights. Respects robots.txt by default with option to override for testing purposes.

tools.name: airbnb_search
tools.description: Search for Airbnb listings with room/building types, dates and guests, plus local minimum-rating and review-count filters. Optional automatic pagination seeks a target number of matches. Optional partial-stay discovery adds clearly labeled shorter stays. Sort fetched results by price, rating, review count or nights covered.

tools.name: airbnb_listing_details
tools.description: Get public details from an Airbnb listing URL or ID, plus live availability, a dated price quote and any cancellation summary when check-in and check-out dates are supplied.

tools.name: airbnb_list_amenities
tools.description: List supported amenity search filter names, labels, and descriptions without making network requests.

ignore_robots_txt.title: Ignore robots.txt
ignore_robots_txt.description: Bypass robots.txt restrictions when making requests to Airbnb. Use with caution and respect Airbnb's terms of service.

disable_geocoding.title: Disable third-party geocoding
disable_geocoding.description: Skip the Photon/Nominatim geocoding step and let Airbnb resolve location strings on its own. Eliminates third-party outbound calls but causes non-US searches (e.g. 'Paris, France') to return wrong results.
